verdicts.reason: A: the label frame sits empty on the left with a stray rule inside it, and all the copy has moved outside the frame to the right. The text order is jumbled (LAVANDER, HOMEMADE LOTION, then J'adore Paris, then SKINCARE). The illustrations are shrunk into a tiny strip and blown-up fragments (soap, butterfly) float around as clutter, so it is unusable. B: keeps the label, the text order and large illustrations, so it reads as the same design. But the divider rules are offset to the right and cut through the frame edge, there is a stray rule at the far right, the type is centered off the frame's axis, and the mortar overlaps the label.
